forbidden.label: @sentry/*
forbidden.reason: Sentry is global error reporting, not a screen feature, but it only runs when environment.sentryDsn is a real https DSN. With the DSN empty it ships and parses for nothing. It must stay reachable ONLY through a dynamic import so the weight follows the feature.

forbidden.label: pdfjs-dist
forbidden.reason: pdf.js renders PDFs inside the document preview modal only. It must stay reachable ONLY through the dynamic import in components/document-preview/pdf-preview-engine.ts, which itself sits behind the lazily loaded viewer.

forbidden.label: docx-preview
forbidden.reason: docx-preview renders DOCX contracts/templates on demand (preview modal, contract AI preview). It must stay reachable ONLY through a dynamic import.
